sections.overview: The Ragfish is a North Pacific fish in the family Icosteidae.
sections.identification: It can exceed two metres and has soft muscles and a cartilaginous skeleton.
sections.habitat: It ranges from Japan to Alaska and California, from the surface to 1420 m.
sections.diet: Reported prey include jellyfish, fish, squid and octopuses.
sections.behavior: Adults occur near the bottom; juveniles stay shallower.
sections.reproduction: Egg and larval records exist, but adult reproduction is poorly documented.
sections.ecology: Larvae have pelvic fins that disappear as adults develop a deeper body.
sections.conservation: FishBase lists no global IUCN status. Adult biology remains poorly studied.
